Brand strategy and visual concept

Young Gold

Give colour a little discipline.

The starting point

Give colour a little discipline.

Colour is part of the service. It can also overwhelm the message when every surface competes for attention. The Young Gold concept keeps the energy of the existing multicolour identity and gives it a more consistent setting.

The work covered

  • Audience and positioning
  • Identity and colour architecture
  • Voice and service presentation
  • Digital, social and field-use guidance

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

The playbook separates the colourful mark from the quieter layouts around it. It also organises services, photography, quote requests and field applications so the identity can be used beyond a single poster. This is a concept edition, with final artwork and details to be confirmed before production.

The words

More than paint. A better space.

The line starts with the service and ends with what the customer gets to enjoy. Supporting messages stay specific about surfaces, preparation and the job in question.
